date_text: Thu, Jul 16th • 12:00 PM AEST - Sun, Jul 19th • 10:00 PM AEST
description: Join us on the rooftop this Thursday as we celebrate some of the best beers Britain has to offer with a These Beers Tap Takeover! We’ll be pouring a cracking lineup of traditional English ales, porters, stouts and lagers. Whether you’re a fan of classic cask-inspired bitters, rich dark beers or bold hop-forward IPAs, there’s something on the bar for every beer lover. Come raise a pint and discover why these breweries have become icons of British brewing. Tap List: 🍺 Badger Fursty Ferret 🍺 Hobsons Plum Porter 🍺 Sullivan’s Black Marble Nitro Stout 🍺 Sullivan’s Maltings Red Ale 🍺 Theakston Best Bitter 🍺 Theakston Old Peculier 🍺 Theakston XB Ruby Ale 🍺 St Austell Proper Job IPA 🍺 St Austell Korev Lager 🍺 St Austell M’Dhu Stout 🍺 St Austell Big Job IPA
